Chapter 01 · The things that matter

You are more than “my girl.”

Ankita, I don't want you to feel special only when I say something romantic. I want to notice you properly: what lifts your mood, what drains your energy, what you need when you're quiet, and what you wish I understood without making you explain it ten times.

Chapter 03 · No dramatic promises

One promise. Kept in real life.

🤝 ♡ 🌙

A promise is love that becomes action.

I won't promise to be perfect or say I'll never make a mistake. I'll promise to listen before defending myself, respect your feelings, and let my actions match what I tell you.

Final chapter · Just for you

Dear Ankita,

This book isn't proof that I've done everything right. It's a reminder that you matter enough for me to put thought into how I treat you.

You don't owe me an instant smile, forgiveness, or an “it's okay.” Take your time. I want to earn the feeling of being someone who makes your life softer—not someone who asks you to feel better just because I tried.

When you tell me what makes you feel loved, I want to take it seriously and show you through what I do next.

♡

Yours, Chetan
